title: fleet_burn: orphaned burn-snapshot.json.<pid>.tmp files accumulate on write failure
description: Codereview of the v0gm/batch (edge pass, kimi-k3). _write_baseline (scripts/fleet_burn.py:61-64): a crash between open(tmp,'w') and os.replace leaves the pid-suffixed tmp behind; guards invoke fleet_burn.py as a fresh process each cycle so PIDs differ and repeated failures (e.g. full disk) accumulate uniquely-named orphans. Low severity (write failure implies bigger problems) but cheap to close: try/finally unlink of tmp on failure, or a fixed tmp name. Existing no-tmp-linger test only covers the success path — add a failure-path test.
